project_name: Connectify Club - Editorial Atelier Visual Consistency & Expansion Blueprint
archetype: ORGANIC & PASTEL ATELIER (Tactile, warm cream canvas #fffaf5, high-contrast ink borders #172337, soft 3D claymation art)

consistency_pass_architecture.audit_summary: 75% of app upgraded to Editorial Atelier design language; 25% legacy screens (Pusat Tantangan / Challenge, Game Over modal, legacy header widgets) need visual alignment with MainLobby & LevelSelectScreen.

one_button_per_feature_matrix.rule: Every game mode entrance (Onet, Block Puzzle, Mini-Games) must route through LevelSelectScreen. Do NOT maintain duplicate 'Quick Play' buttons alongside 'Select Level'.
one_button_per_feature_matrix.action_item: Unify all 'Play' triggers across navigation tabs to direct to LevelSelectScreen.

one_button_per_feature_matrix.rule: Game Over screens must offer exactly 1 primary CTA button: 'Kembali ke Level Select' (or 'Main Lagi' routing through LevelSelectState), preserving exact level & theme state upon return.
one_button_per_feature_matrix.action_item: Ensure Game Over modal does not drop player back into a disconnected legacy lobby.

one_button_per_feature_matrix.rule: Coins/Permen wallet display in header acts as the single gateway to ShopScreen; individual item buy triggers exist only within Shop catalog cards.
one_button_per_feature_matrix.action_item: Remove inline redundant purchase popups outside ShopScreen.

one_button_per_feature_matrix.rule: MobileNav bottom bar has 1 button per core tab: [Home, Playing/Levels, Shop, Collection, Profile]. The 'Playing' tab opens canonical LevelSelectScreen directly.
one_button_per_feature_matrix.action_item: Ensure Playing tab tab-click renders LevelSelectScreen immediately with active theme previews.

canonical_level_select_flow.game_over_return: GameplayScreen (Game Over / Victory) -> 'Level Select' button -> LevelSelectScreen (scroll restored)
canonical_level_select_flow.challenge_mode_integration: Challenge/Pusat Tantangan uses LevelSelectScreen layout structure with custom challenge badge overlays.

art_direction_blueprint.existing_asset_preservation_policy: STRICT MANDATE: ALL existing bitmap assets in /public/art/ (including sakura, bakery, galaxy, meadow, fruit, candy, forest, ocean, space, avatars, chests, skins, and premium sets) MUST REMAIN UNCHANGED. No files removed or modified.
art_direction_blueprint.asset_format_preference: Prioritize high-detail bitmap artwork (.webp, 512x512 translucent clay/vector sprites) over flat decorative SVGs. SVGs permitted only for functional UI controls and icons.

accessibility.testing_attribute: MUST add data-testid attribute in kebab-case format to every interactive element (e.g. data-testid='level-select-card-1', data-testid='shop-item-buy-button-avatar_fox')
accessibility.contrast: Ensure all text meets APCA & WCAG AA contrast standards against pastel cards and backgrounds.

3d_libraries.recommendation: Use Canvas 2D / CSS3D for tile rendering and board animations; Framer Motion for celebratory popups

instructions_to_main_agent: Unify 100% of screens (including LevelSelectScreen, ChallengeScreen, Game Over modal, and ShopScreen) under the 2px ink border (#172337) and offset shadow ([3px_3px_0px_#172337]) visual language.
Enforce the 1 Button per Feature rule: duplicate play buttons across screens must be eliminated, routing all game launches through canonical LevelSelectScreen.
Playing tab and Game Over menu MUST use LevelSelectScreen state directly so returning to lobby/playing tab always keeps user on their selected level view.
Register the 4 NEW premium themes (Autumn Harvest, Magic Atelier, Retro Arcade, Alpine Winter) alongside the 15 existing themes in theme registry and shop catalog.
Add cosmetic catalog items (avatars, frames, tile skins, block textures, burst effects) with Permen coin pricing.
DO NOT modify or delete any existing images in /public/art/ or /src/assets/.
Add kebab-case data-testid to all interactive components.

UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT.testing_attribute: MUST add data-testid to every interactive component (e.g. data-testid='play-onet-button')
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT.anti_ai_slop: Avoid centered default layouts or generic flat gradients. Preserve tactile ink borders, organic pastel hues, and crisp typography.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT.no_transparent_overlays: Headers, floating menus, and modals MUST have solid/frosted non-transparent backgrounds (bg-white/90 or solid #fffaf5 with backdrop-blur).
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT.spacing: Maintain generous 2-3x padding inside cards and modals to prevent touch target overlap on mobile.
